instructions: Add prompts only for verified database slugs.
Keep every prompt original and do not reference or copy third-party artwork.
Review generated images before adding them to images.json.

fields.slug: Must match a verified item, coin, or accessory slug.
fields.usage: Describe where the image will appear.
fields.aspectRatio: Record the intended ratio, such as square or landscape.
fields.prompt: Write an original generation prompt without external asset references.
fields.alt: Describe the intended image clearly and uniquely.
